verdict.rationale: Kong's decK CLI supports declarative export/import of Gateway configuration as open YAML/JSON files, and Kong explicitly touts 'no vendor lock-in' for its declarative deployment model, giving users a path to extract their configuration and leave. However, evidence doesn't show export of other data types (logs, analytics, AI Gateway traffic data, Konnect catalog/dev-portal content) in open formats, nor independent confirmation of a full data-export workflow. Missing for 10: documented export of logs/analytics/observability data, Konnect-hosted data export options, and independent/hands-on verification of a complete 'leave with your data' workflow.
